name: manual_32bd56
claim: In PowerShell, capture native command output and return a scalar from boolean helper functions; uncaptured output joins the return value.

decisions.notes: Invoke-LanPeerProbe returned probe stdout plus false, a truthy array, so failed probes flushed the outbox to unreachable peers.
